sentences.text_target: Tom is feeling very tired this afternoon.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm ɪz ˈfiːlɪŋ ˈvɛri ˈtaɪəd ðɪs ˈɑːftənuːn/
sentences.text_native: Tom se sent très fatigué cet après-midi.

sentences.text_target: He has a bad stomach ache.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː hæz ə bæd ˈstʌmək eɪk/
sentences.text_native: Il a un terrible mal de ventre.

sentences.text_target: He decides to walk to the local pharmacy.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː dɪˈsaɪdz tuː wɔːk tuː ðə ˈləʊkəl ˈfɑːməsi/
sentences.text_native: Il décide de marcher jusqu'à la pharmacie de quartier.

sentences.text_target: The pharmacy is on a busy street corner.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈfɑːməsi ɪz ɒn ə ˈbɪzi striːt ˈkɔːnə/
sentences.text_native: La pharmacie est au coin d'une rue animée.

sentences.text_target: He pushes the glass door open.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈpʊʃɪz ðə glɑːs dɔːr ˈəʊpən/
sentences.text_native: Il pousse la porte vitrée pour l'ouvrir.

sentences.text_target: A small bell rings above his head.
sentences.phonetic: /ə smɔːl bɛl rɪŋz əˈbʌv hɪz hɛd/
sentences.text_native: Une petite cloche tinte au-dessus de sa tête.

sentences.text_target: There are three people waiting inside.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeər ɑː θriː ˈpiːpl ˈweɪtɪŋ ɪnˈsaɪd/
sentences.text_native: Il y a trois personnes qui attendent à l'intérieur.

sentences.text_target: Tom joins the quiet queue.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm ʤɔɪnz ðə ˈkwaɪət kjuː/
sentences.text_native: Tom se met dans la file d'attente calme.

sentences.text_target: After a short wait, it is his turn.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːftər ə ʃɔːt weɪt, ɪt ɪz hɪz tɜːn/
sentences.text_native: Après une courte attente, c'est son tour.

sentences.text_target: A kind pharmacist greets him with a smile.
sentences.phonetic: /ə kaɪnd ˈfɑːməsɪst griːts hɪm wɪð ə smaɪl/
sentences.text_native: Un pharmacien aimable l'accueille avec un sourire.

sentences.text_target: The friendly man asks about his health problem.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈfrɛndli mæn ɑːsks əˈbaʊt hɪz hɛlθ ˈprɒbləm/
sentences.text_native: L'homme sympathique l'interroge sur son problème de santé.

sentences.text_target: Tom explains his pain clearly.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm ɪkˈspleɪnz hɪz peɪn ˈklɪəli/
sentences.text_native: Tom explique clairement sa douleur.

sentences.text_target: The professional listens very carefully.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə prəˈfɛʃənl ˈlɪsnz ˈvɛri ˈkeəfʊli/
sentences.text_native: Le professionnel l'écoute très attentivement.

sentences.text_target: He does not need a doctor's prescription today.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː dʌz nɒt niːd ə ˈdɒktəz prɪsˈkrɪpʃən təˈdeɪ/
sentences.text_native: Il n'a pas besoin d'ordonnance de médecin aujourd'hui.

sentences.text_target: The pharmacist recommends a special medical syrup.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈfɑːməsɪst ˌrɛkəˈmɛndz ə ˈspɛʃəl ˈmɛdɪkəl ˈsɪrəp/
sentences.text_native: Le pharmacien recommande un sirop médical spécial.

sentences.text_target: He turns around to reach the high shelf.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː tɜːnz əˈraʊnd tuː riːʧ ðə haɪ ʃɛlf/
sentences.text_native: Il se retourne pour atteindre l'étagère en hauteur.

sentences.text_target: He takes a small glass bottle.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː teɪks ə smɔːl glɑːs ˈbɒtl/
sentences.text_native: Il prend une petite bouteille en verre.

sentences.text_target: He also puts a small box of tablets on the counter.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈɔːlsəʊ pʊts ə smɔːl bɒks ɒv ˈtæblɪts ɒn ðə ˈkaʊntə/
sentences.text_native: Il pose également une petite boîte de comprimés sur le comptoir.

sentences.text_target: Tom looks at the total price.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm lʊks æt ðə ˈtəʊtl praɪs/
sentences.text_native: Tom regarde le prix total.

sentences.text_target: The products cost fifteen euros.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈprɒdʌkts kɒst fɪfˈtiːn ˈjʊərəʊz/
sentences.text_native: Les produits coûtent quinze euros.

sentences.text_target: Tom takes his bank card from his pocket.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm teɪks hɪz bæŋk kɑːd frɒm hɪz ˈpɒkɪt/
sentences.text_native: Tom sort sa carte bancaire de sa poche.

sentences.text_target: He pays for the items quickly.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː peɪz fɔː ðə ˈaɪtəmz ˈkwɪkli/
sentences.text_native: Il paye les articles rapidement.

sentences.text_target: The pharmacist puts everything inside a paper bag.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈfɑːməsɪst pʊts ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɪnˈsaɪd ə ˈpeɪpə bæg/
sentences.text_native: Le pharmacien met le tout dans un sac en papier.

sentences.text_target: He gives the receipt and the bag to Tom.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː gɪvz ðə rɪˈsiːt ænd ðə bæg tuː tɒm/
sentences.text_native: Il donne le ticket de caisse et le sac à Tom.

sentences.text_target: Tom says thank you in a polite voice.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm sɛɪz θæŋk juː ɪn ə pəˈlaɪt vɔɪs/
sentences.text_native: Tom dit merci d'une voix polie.

sentences.text_target: He says goodbye and turns to the exit.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː sɛɪz gʊdˈbaɪ ænd tɜːnz tuː ði ˈɛksɪt/
sentences.text_native: Il dit au revoir et se dirige vers la sortie.

sentences.text_target: He steps back out into the fresh afternoon air.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː stɛps bæk aʊt ˈɪntuː ðə frɛʃ ˈɑːftənuːn eə/
sentences.text_native: Il ressort à l'air frais de l'après-midi.

sentences.text_target: He walks back home slowly.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː wɔːks bæk həʊm ˈsləʊli/
sentences.text_native: Il rentre chez lui lentement à pied.

sentences.text_target: He hopes to feel much better soon.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː həʊps tuː fiːl mʌtʃ ˈbɛtə suːn/
sentences.text_native: Il espère se sentir beaucoup mieux bientôt.

sentences.text_target: Now he is resting safely in his room.
sentences.phonetic: /naʊ hiː ɪz ˈrɛstɪŋ ˈseɪfli ɪn hɪz ruːm/
sentences.text_native: Maintenant, il se repose tranquillement dans sa chambre.
